sampling_method.description: Stratified reproducible sample: (1) per-artifact positions at 10/40/70/90% of statement_id-ordered lists; (2) quota picks from content bins by statement_id stride; (3) forced inclusion from Pass-1 repetition and unclear pools; (4) longer multi-clause candidates; (5) fill to 30 via statement_id-ordered walk with stride 17 from index 3.
sampling_method.seed_note: No RNG; selection fully determined by statement_id order and fixed fractions/strides.
